signals.thesis: An HN post reports that Opus 5.5 AI agents identified two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates, signaling that frontier AI models are being used to accelerate materials discovery. This points to growing claims of AI-driven scientific breakthroughs, which could influence both AI model valuations and materials/semiconductor research investment narratives.
signals.title: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 agents flag novel magnetic semiconductor candidates

signals.thesis: A newly announced Web Search API is generating significant discussion, suggesting a notable product move in the AI/search tooling space that could intensify competition among AI and search providers. The scale of engagement indicates developers see it as a meaningful shift in how search capabilities are integrated into applications.
signals.title: New Web Search API launch draws major developer attention
